purpose: Qualify a repository-native real-HeadCalc fixed-Hc research carrier with legacy-native centimetre geometry and resolved upper-30-cm state before any renewed H2 probe.
classification_boundary: real HeadCalc + explicit B110 constitutive provider
not Hupsel and not a full real-SWAP application case

geometry.rationale: Preserve the 300 cm column scale visible in LOW01 native-unit authority while resolving the upper 30 cm with six 5 cm compartments.

hydraulics.parameters: same uniform parameter tuple already used by F-GC44 research fixture
hydraulics.initial_profile: hydrostatic in native cm geometry, constructed by cumulative node distances
hydraulics.bottom_datum_rule: for native-cm research geometry, bottom boundary elevation = -total_depth_cm/100 m

qualification_gates: node diagnostic exposes exactly the frozen 17-node geometry and is read-only
baseline h_i + z_i is constant within 1e-12 cm
upper 30 cm overlaps exactly six nodes and reconstructed root-water uses 30 cm in native geometry
profile-water/root-water/M1 reconstruct from node state within 1e-12 native units
computed reference interface head is finite and lies within [-0.79,-0.76] m
a zero-top read-only interval at reference head and 1e-4 d is completed, mass-complete and origin-preserving

forcing_characterization.execution: fresh baseline, commit=false for every point
forcing_characterization.response_access: bottom exchange is not persisted or used; only transaction/admissibility/mass diagnostics are retained

next_activation.rule: Only if C02 qualifies and at least one magnitude-duration point is admitted in both signs may GC-RZM06C03 preregister an H2 state-construction experiment.
